title: Choose a Home and Report a Problem
description: Complete a practical housing mission with questions and a polite problem report.

data.heading: Choose, ask, report
data.body: First ask about the home, then clearly state a simple household problem.

items.en: Is there a washing machine in the flat?

data.transcript_cz: Dobrý den, v bytě nefunguje pračka. Můžete mi prosím pomoct? Jsem doma dnes odpoledne.

data.prompt_en: Choose the option that matches the need.
data.text_cz: Byt A je levnější a blízko metra, ale je menší. Byt B je větší, má balkon a pračku, ale je dál od centra. Pro rodinu je byt B lepší.
data.text_en: Flat A is cheaper and near the metro, but smaller. Flat B is larger, has a balcony and washing machine, but is farther from the centre. For a family flat B is better.

questions.question_en: Which flat has a washing machine?
Which flat is closer to the metro?

blank_answers: Nefunguje topení. Můžete mi prosím pomoct?

data.prompt_en: Write 3 sentences: choose one flat, ask one practical question, and report one simple problem.
data.sample_answer: Byt B je pro mě lepší. Je v bytě pračka? Nefunguje topení, můžete mi prosím pomoct?

data.prompt_en: Record 20–30 seconds choosing a flat and reporting a simple household issue.
